$comment: Advisories accepted after assessing exposure in this application.
Each entry needs a reason and a reviewOn date. An expired entry fails the
build, so accepted risk gets revisited instead of quietly accumulating.
Anything not listed here still fails CI at high severity.

allow.reason: Reaches us through the Prisma CLI, a development and migration tool. It is absent from the web image and present in the worker image only to generate the client; the stack-exhaustion path needs a recursive object graph we never hand it.

mysql2 is bundled inside the Prisma CLI, which supports several database engines. This project's datasource provider is postgresql and no MySQL connection is ever opened, so the auth-plugin downgrade cannot be reached: it requires connecting to a hostile MySQL server. The CLI is absent from the web image and present in the worker image, which needs it to generate the client, but is never pointed at MySQL there either.
Same bundled Prisma CLI dependency. The decompression bomb needs a MySQL server speaking the compressed protocol, and this project never connects to MySQL.
